name: Candle GitHub repository (Hugging Face Rust ML framework)
notes: README: 'Candle is a minimalist ML framework for Rust with a focus on performance (including GPU support) and ease of use.' Dual MIT/Apache-2.0 licensing. Crates published as candle-core; docs at docs.rs. Browser/WASM examples shipped as HF Spaces: whisper, LLaMA2, T5 generation, yolo pose/object recognition, Segment Anything.
